verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/corporate_disclosures.py:1095-1103 (get_shareholding) and :532-547 (get_announcements) decide whether the India-only lanes apply by bare-ticker membership in the NSE/BSE masters (symbol_resolver.is_nse_symbol/is_bse_symbol). They never check which instrument the session binds. The router cache (routers/disclosures.py:89) and the announcements cache (corporate_disclosures.py:606) key on the bare symbol alone. The 806a90c fix changed only ownership_check.is_applicable, which is the research path.
verdicts.fix_shape: Add one helper in corporate_disclosures that decides an India listing the way the research witnesses do. A .NS/.BO suffix counts as Indian. A bare ticker counts only when symbol_resolver.resolve(bare, config.get_region()) binds an NSE or BSE instrument. Call the helper at the top of get_shareholding and get_announcements, and in the sibling results, corporate-actions and deals lanes, which use the same membership gate. When it says no, return the existing _not_applicable coverage. Run the check before the router's cache read and before get_announcements_cached's cache read, or add the region to the cache key, so a cached IN answer is never served to a US session.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:320-322, with the allowlist at :220-258. A dotted symbol whose suffix is not among the 37 entries in _YAHOO_EXCHANGE_SUFFIXES falls through to s.replace('.', '-'). Every Yahoo exchange the list omits (SR, F, BA, BE, MU, NE, PR, QA, CA, ...) is therefore dashed into a symbol Yahoo does not serve.
verdicts.fix_shape: Recognise the US share-class quirk directly instead of listing foreign exchanges. In _yahoo_symbol, after the .NS/.BO/^ and India cases, dash-rewrite a dotted symbol only when its dashed form is a US-master ticker (symbol_resolver.is_us_symbol(s.replace('.', '-'))); this is True for BRK-B and BF-B. Pass every other dotted symbol through unchanged. _YAHOO_EXCHANGE_SUFFIXES is then unused and can be deleted.

verdicts.note: The entry's named examples are fixed at HEAD: BHP.AX, 0700.HK, 7203.T and VOD.L all return 200 from yfinance. The class that the fix_shape names ('pass every other recognised exchange suffix through unchanged') is not fixed. The fix swapped a universal rewrite for a finite 37-suffix allowlist. In-process, _yahoo_symbol maps 2222.SR to 2222-SR, SAP.F to SAP-F and GGAL.BA to GGAL-BA, and does the same to BMW.BE, SIE.MU, EQB.NE, CEZ.PR, QNBK.QA and COMI.CA. Live, /quotes/2222.SR, /quotes/SAP.F and /quotes/GGAL.BA return 404 not_found 'check the symbol', although Yahoo serves the dot forms (SAR 25.78, EUR 185.2, ARS 6290) and returns nothing for the dashed ones. One correction to the verifier: OPAP.AT is a bad example, because Yahoo has no data for OPAP.AT in either form, so it proves only the mapping. Severity stays high: quoting, a core flow, is broken for every listing on an exchange the list omits, including Saudi Tadawul and Frankfurt, and the 404 wrongly tells the user the symbol is invalid.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/exchange_financials.py:114-121. FiledPeriods.cadence() returns 'half-yearly' whenever trailing() (:97-112) finds any hole in the trailing-year chain; it never looks at period lengths. correctness_gate.py:581-585 then labels the company '(a half-yearly filer)' and the figure 'annual, not trailing-4Q'. NDTV's Sep-2025 Integrated Filing XBRL carries only an Apr-Sep 2025 context. So a quarterly filer with one quarter exposed as a 6-month period is labelled half-yearly.
verdicts.fix_shape: Make cadence() decide from period lengths, as the fix_shape asks. Return 'half-yearly' only when the fiscal half that contains the trailing-year hole has no filed 3-month period, since a half-yearly filer never files a quarter. When a 3-month period is filed inside that half (NDTV filed Apr-Jun 2025 inside Apr-Sep 2025), return a distinct cadence such as 'quarterly-gap'. Have _ttm_basis give that cadence the existing gap wording: the exchange filings leave a quarter of the trailing year unfiled or unparsed; kept, flagged. The reason must not mention 'half-yearly filer' or 'annual, not trailing-4Q'.

verdicts.note: The entry's own repro reproduces at HEAD. Live GET /fundamentals/NDTV on :52400 returns revenue_ttm and net_income_ttm reasons of 'TTM basis: the exchange filings do not cover the trailing year in four quarters (a half-yearly filer), annual, not trailing-4Q; kept, flagged'. NDTV is a mainboard quarterly filer, and the lane's own periods show it: 3-month filings for Apr-Jun 2025, Oct-Dec 2025, Jan-Mar 2026 and Apr-Jun 2026. Only the Sep-2025 filing appears as a 6-month Apr-Sep period, because that XBRL has only 2025-04-01..2025-09-30 contexts. cadence() treats any hole as proof of a half-yearly filer, so the label misstates the company's filing cadence and describes Yahoo's figure's basis without support. The batch-7 cases were genuinely correct: TCS gets no reason with four quarters, and DHANBANK is served its filed quarters. Neither is a quarterly filer with a hole in its filed chain, so this shape was never tested. Severity stays medium: the label is a wrong annotation, while the value itself is unchanged and flagged.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/bse_provider.py:630 sets quote.volume to the raw TTQ field of the StockTrading/w payload and ignores that payload's TTQin unit field. For liquid scrips TTQin is '(Lakh)': INFY 500209 has TTQ '8.12' and RELIANCE 500325 has '5.28'. Separately, sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:618-628 (_quote_from_history) and :584-594 (_quote_from_payload) build the nse_direct Quote without open/high/low/prev_close. The historicalOR row (bars[0]) and the computed prev already hold those values. The batch-10 fix never touched nse_provider.
verdicts.fix_shape: In bse_provider._fetch_scrip_header, scale TTQ by its stated unit. Multiply by 100,000 when TTQin contains 'Lakh' and by 10,000,000 when it contains 'Cr'. Treat any other non-empty unit as unknown and serve volume None. In nse_provider._quote_from_history, pass open, high and low from bars[0] and prev_close=prev into Quote. Likewise map priceInfo.previousClose to prev_close in _quote_from_payload.

verdicts.note: The headline repros hold at HEAD on :52400. ICON (bse) now has volume 1200 and open/high/low/prev_close, and AMAL.BO (bse) has volume 5406 and a day range. Bare AMAL is now served by nse_direct with volume 13368. Two stated parts of the thin-quote class still fail. (A) The session volume the fix reads from BSE StockTrading/w is in lakh units for liquid scrips. INFY.BO shows volume 8.12 and RELIANCE.BO (and 500325.BO) show 5.28, while the product's own BSE history bar for INFY on 2026-09-25 shows 811,562 shares; the raw payload is TTQ '8.12', TTQin '(Lakh)'. The register's batch-13 note had already folded this lakh artifact into this entry, and it sits inside the fix_shape's 'fetch session volume from StockTrading'. rc1-vshard-9:5 is therefore correctly deduped here: a partial on this entry, not a new defect. (B) The entry's own raw DAT-P13-4 (ELCIDIN day range absent) reproduces unchanged. ELCIDIN was served by nse_direct at entry time and still is, with open/high/low/prev_close null; bare AMAL and INFY.NS are the same. The verifier's claim holds on both counts. Severity is raised from medium to high. A missing volume became a wrong one, 100,000 times too low, on every liquid .BO quote and on the bse fallback whenever the NSE lanes fail, and the research brief renders it as 'Volume'. It is not critical because the number is implausible on sight and no valuation metric uses it. The NSE OHLC gap alone would be low, because no frontend code reads quote open/high/low/prev_close.
